title: Pukka Juice 5000+ Blackcurrant Menthol 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pukka Juice 5000+ Blackcurrant Menthol Nic Salt e-liquid delivers a luscious combination of bold, juicy Blackcurrant and a cooling Menthol exhale. The rich, sweet taste of ripe Blackcurrant is perfectly balanced by the fresh, icy Menthol, making this e-liquid a great choice for those who enjoy fruity and frosty flavours. Designed with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Pukka Juice 5000+ Nic Salts are ideal for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod systems. These e-liquids provide smooth throat hits and fast nicotine relief, offering a satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco products. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Blackcurrant Menthol offers a refreshing all-day vape. Pukka Juice are a multi-award-winning UK vape brand known for their bold and diverse e-liquid creations. The Pukka Juice 5000+ collection captures the flavours of disposable vapes in a more versatile format for use with refillable devices. Try other popular flavours like Lime Twist, Blue Sour Razz, and Berry Blast.
